component_rules: Centralize manifest name, project schema, neutral filenames, workbench protocol, BuildReport schema, and product identity per language boundary.
Use shared cross-runtime fixtures when Python, TypeScript, and Rust express the same request, response, progress, diagnostic, or output contract.
Keep generic metadata and optional academic profile as typed project and template values rather than parser, adapter, or renderer conditionals.
Reuse the existing workspace operation, cancellation, stale-result, diagnostic, preview, and transport abstractions instead of adding DocForge-specific duplicates.
Extract a shared utility or service only when a second implementation would otherwise repeat path validation, serialization, metadata binding, or formatting behavior.
